name: kalyanam-matrimonial-platform
description: Premium Indian Matrimonial Platform (React + Node.js + PostgreSQL + Prisma + Tailwind CSS)

scripts.build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm run server:install && npm run client:install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../server && npx tsc --noEmit
